name: Vizard
summary: Vizard: AI clipping of long videos into social-ready shorts.
description: Vizard detects highlights in webinars and podcasts, reframes for vertical, and adds captions for TikTok, Reels, and LinkedIn.
features: Auto highlight detection from long-form video.
Reframe and crop for 9:16 social formats.
Team workspace and direct social publishing.
